verdict.rationale: Quo ships its own public REST API with published OpenAPI 3.1 specs, a live per-endpoint playground (e.g. list calls) and a formal versioning policy. Its MCP server, which sits alongside the API, documents messaging, call history, transcripts and contact create/update. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that the API matches the UI, so full parity is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit API-equals-UI parity claim; API coverage of UI features such as phone menus, ring orders, call routing, number provisioning, Sona and AI call tags; independent or hands-on confirmation of API breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Quo API enables developers to integrate powerful communication features directly into their applications and workflows.
